title: Give a signed copy to a couple you love.
body: $20 plus $8 shipping sends a signed copy of Never Fight or Argue Again, with the name you choose on the inscription and your gift note. We mail it to the address you enter at checkout.
thanks_body: Your gift is confirmed and a receipt is on its way to your inbox. We will sign it and mail it to the address you entered. Thank you for loving a couple well.
